recaps.text: England beat Australia by seven wickets (DLS) in the third T20I at the Gabba, with Jamie Overton taking 5 for 12, to lead the series 2-1.
Bears beat the Lions 39-35 on Rome Odunze's late touchdown to lead the NFC North, and Bills beat the Chiefs 13-10 in the rain on a 57-yard Tyler Bass field goal.
Gukesh and Sindarov drew Game 3 of the world championship in 60 moves, leaving the match level at 1.5-1.5 before Friday's rest day.

lookAhead: Saturday has chess Game 4 (9:00 AM), the UK Championship snooker from 8:00 AM, and England v New Zealand in the Nations Championship (11:40 AM); Sunday has the Jets at the Dolphins (1:00 PM) and Manchester City at Arsenal (11:30 AM).
